card.name: Symptomatic treatment in overdosage sections
card.fires_on: The ending piece "omatic" of the word symptomatic, when it follows "sympt" in overdose text saying treatment should be symptomatic and supportive.

modes.label: Treatment should be symptomatic
modes.description: The "omatic" ending of symptomatic after "treatment should be" in an overdosage statement.
modes.example: In the event of overdosage, treatment should be sympt<<omatic>> and supportive.

modes.label: Given symptomatic treatment
modes.description: The same ending after "given" in a list of overdose management steps.
modes.example: carefully observed and given sympt<<omatic>> and supportive treatment.
